notes.title: New IDEA 2.0 major update available!
notes.content:
You can reset your progress to start again from scratch
Ideas can now be up to 100-characters long
Improved the network settings (and now you will get a notification it there's an issue with your connection)
Improved UI
A network window has been added
Better management of Ideas
It's now easier to find other players Ideas
Endings show more Ideas
You can filter Ideas by language
You can filter Ideas by priority
You can ban some Ideas or fav their authors (their ideas will always appear on top of the Idea list)
You can ban some Ideas or fav them (the ones from these users will always appear on top of the Idea list)
Fixed some language issues
Achievements are now visible so players can complete them
Tutorial will now start automatically for new players
Ideas are now cross-platform

notes.title: Patch 1.4 available for IDEA!
notes.content:
Morning loving players! ❤️

Many players reported to us that they had problems saving their IDEAs, so we are happy and pleased to announce that we have completed the maintenance and testing of the new IDEA server. 

In addition to this, we have fixed many issues in the localization of the game.

You can save and share your ideas with another players now.

Thank you for playing IDEA!

notes.title: New update available!
notes.content:
Hi players! It is a pleasure to announce a new patch for IDEA!
This is the second patch in Steam (v1.2). 
We have checked and solved this:

- Many errors during connection to IDEA server.
- IDEAs can be stored now in the diferent languages of the game and shared with all.
- Many localization errors solved.
- Missing characters in Spanish, Chinese, Japanese and Korean solved.
- New optimized animations.
- Tutorial is mandatory the first time you play.
- Cursor size increased.
- Now the language changed is stored.
- Another many small bugs fixed.

notes.title: Official Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
We have been holding our breath for too long before giving you this announcement…
Idea will be released on the 8th of March and it’s going to be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, iOS and Android.

From the whole team behind the game development, we want to express our deepest gratitude to all the people who accompanied us along the way:  the fans, the dev community, and those who believed in our project until the end and spread the word about Idea.

As we think: “it’s not about the goal, it’s about the journey”. We’ll always keep the good memories of all the events we participated in and all the people we met thanks to this game.

Let’s stop this before we get too emotional, and let’s talk about the game. On the full release you will have:

[h1]7 different endings[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41812843/f4c70a3368c164baa2efc1da00bd1f54e11468be.gif[/img]
In the demo, you were allowed to reach one ending. Now there are 7 different endings for you to explore, and each one of them includes an achievement! What is waiting for you at the end? It’s only up to you to find out :) but don’t focus so much on the objective and enjoy the road.

[h1]This road is made of 113 levels[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41812843/7162343185cc342f1f060bff171e0c14c4c062ef.gif[/img]
Idea’s levels are based on the drone-recorded footage of Olli Huttunen. The landscapes will change from woods to highways, from towns to rivers. Your lightbulb will move on towards a goal, using the seasons as markers of creative progress. So prepare to experience not only different locations but different weather conditions.

[h1]More than 20 hidden achievements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41812843/936951d024408e9783a36e76f12451bd6a21cf2c.gif[/img]
There’s no denying it- achieving and collecting things is pretty nice. Some achievements are related to the endings, while others are related to the gameplay. From the main menu, you’ll be able to check your progress and see which achievements you unlocked and which ones are still out there for you to discover.

[h1]Interacting with the world[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41812843/f465db6c9fe10dd7264376448e59589532a0699d.gif[/img]
When you leave an idea, you can choose an icon to personalise it. In the full version, there are 150 icons for you to choose from. Decide which one fits better the content that you are sharing, the environment surrounding that idea or your own personality.

We are very excited to receive comments from you all playing the release version of Idea, and can’t wait for March 8th to come.
